pages.text: $(thing)The Moon$() is a pretty rocky place wherever you go, but it still has a few different biomes to explore that you may be interested in.$(br2)Looking for somewhere specific? Only some biomes can spawn near each other, with the $(l:the_moon/moon_biomes#sands)Lunar Sands$() and $(l:the_moon/moon_biomes#plains)Lunar Plains$() serving as a sort of "neutral ground" between them all.

pages.title: Lunar Plains
pages.text: $(thing)Lunar Plains$() don't really have anything interesting going on, but they're a nice neutral place to make a base.

pages.title: Lunar Sands
pages.text: $(thing)Lunar Sands$() are an alternate version of Lunar Plains that have less vegetation but more sand.

pages.title: Asurine Fields
pages.text: $(thing)Asurine Fields$() has frequent formations of $(item)Asurine$(). It cannot spawn near $(l:the_moon/moon_biomes#forest)Chorus$() biomes.

pages.title: Certus Fields
pages.text: $(thing)Certus Fields$() larger formations of $(item)Asurine$() that also contain large amounts of $(item)Certus Quartz$().

pages.title: Chorus Forest
pages.text: The $(thing)Chorus Forest$() is the only place to find $(l:the_moon/moon_crops)Chorus Fruit$(). It cannot spawn near $(l:the_moon/moon_biomes#asurine)Asurine$() biomes.

pages.title: Chorus Thicket
pages.text: The $(thing)Chorus Thicket$() is a dense area of $(l:the_moon/moon_crops)Chorus Fruit$(). It is a dangerous biome with hostile $(l:the_moon/moon_fauna#endermen)endermen$().

pages.title: Lunar Maria
pages.text: The $(thing)Lunar Maria$() contains some $(item)dead coral$() and sand. It cannot spawn near $(l:the_moon/moon_biomes#lightbloom)Lightbloom$() biomes.

pages.title: Lunar Reef
pages.text: The $(thing)Lunar Reef$() has many large formations of dead coral. Did the moon have oceans in the distant past?

pages.title: Lightbloom Scrubland
pages.text: $(thing)Lightbloom Scrublands$() have some sparse growths of $(item)Lightblooms$(). It cannot spawn near $(l:the_moon/moon_biomes#maria)Coral$() biomes.

pages.title: Lightbloom Star Gazers
pages.text: Many $(item)Lightblooms$() grow here. $(bold)Tip:$() This biome looks beautiful at night time with shaders on!

The $(item)Moon Dust Harvester$() is an optional multiblock that collects $(thing)lunar regolith$(). This regolith can then be processed into $(thing)infinite sources of certain ores$()!$(br)The downside? There's four types of regolith and each can only be harvested in a certain biome, so if you want all of them, you'll have to set up some $(l:logistics/trains)infrastructure$().
Upgrading the $(item)coils$() will reduce the energy cost. $(l:logistics/trains#cargo)Accumulators$() can be used to transport energy around.
$(item)Certus Regolith Dust$() can only be harvested in the $(l:the_moon/moon_biomes#certus)Certus Fields$() biome.$(br2)It can be processed into $(item)Certus Quartz$() and $(item)Zinc$().
$(item)Cassiterite Regolith Dust$() requires the $(l:the_moon/moon_biomes#stargazers)Lightbloom Star Gazers$() biome.$(br2)It is a source of $(item)Tin$().
$(item)Goethe Regolith Dust$() is harvested in the $(l:the_moon/moon_biomes#thicket)Chorus Thicket$() biome.$(br2)It can be processed into $(item)Copper$() and $(item)Iron$().
$(item)Bright Regolith Dust$() is from the $(l:the_moon/moon_biomes#reef)Lunar Reef$() biome.$(br2)It is a source of $(item)Diamond$() and $(item)Gold$().

As part of their processing, all of these $(thing)Regolith Dusts$() are turned into $(item)Dusty Ores$(). These can only be centrifuged for resources for now - further extraction will require some lategame ore processing on $(l:venus)Venus$().$(br2)Be sure to use a $(item)Large Chemical Reactor$() to get perfect overclocking on these recipes! If you want to set up more passive automation for $(thing)AE2 components$() or $(l:logistics/railgun)Railgun Ammo$(), these regolith harvesters are essential!
